verdict.rationale: Angular Signals (angular-docs-1) provide a built-in fine-grained reactivity primitive that can be used for shared/global state via injectable services holding signals, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents a dedicated global-state-management pattern or API (like a store) built into Angular. missing for 10: explicit documentation of signals-based global state management pattern, first-party guidance on app-wide state without services/DI boilerplate, independent corroboration of using signals for global state.
